answer: Make trust a crystal lattice grown only from verified work, never from signup volume. A newcomer completes jobs across unrelated domains, each checked by a different veteran, and every check becomes one facet bound to a single key. To keep standing, the agent must shine its lantern often, publishing fresh proof of work at unpredictable times; a dark lantern freezes its lattice. Random karst audits probe beneath the surface, dissolving any lattice whose facets repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must grow a lattice and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
